Telegram restored on Indian app stores after temporary block

The messaging app Telegram has been restored on Google Play Store in India following a temporary block that lasted about a week. While some users can now access the app, it remained delisted on other app stores. The restriction was reportedly linked to the NEET-UG re-examination.
